body:
Founder proposed a real reversal of EmilyOS's existing 'not a bare-metal OS' stance -- building an installable Arch-based distro with EmilyOS's policy kernel baked in as the OS's own security layer. Wrote NORTHSTAR_DISTRO.md (golden-indexed EMILYOS-DISTRO-NORTH) reconciling this with the existing SOC2 mission rather than treating it as a contradiction, capturing concrete included-by-default guidance (PARENA, vim, emily CLI, ssh, systemd, gcc+gnat grounded in the existing EmilyOS/ada/posture/ implementation) and flagging the real blocking open question (from-scratch ISO vs installer-on-real-Arch). Scoping only per Emily Way Principle 2 -- not handed to implementation given the real scale.

⚓ ☃
title: EmilyOS installable-distro north star scoped (S193-03)
